description: Query a live data source through Marco Polo. Returns real-time data (ground truth). Natural language query is translated to SQL/API call. Always tag results as [LIVE DATA].

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for results beyond the limit

datasource.description: Name of the data source to query (from velixar_list_sources)

query.description: Natural language query (e.g., "show me churn rate by quarter for the last year")

show_query.description: Return the generated SQL alongside results (default: false)

name: velixar_query_source
